name: dshd-gui
description: Deepartments GUI/`/deepartments` RPC channel: the PURE server-half dispatcher (dispatchDeepartmentsEndpoint + the 6 endpoints agents/list, host/status, presence/get, presence/set, agenda/list), the client-request envelope validator (parseClientEnvelope), the authority/trust fence (isLoopbackHostname/parseAuthority/isTrustedAuthority/isTrustedHostFact), the thin node:http route handler (handleDeepartmentsRequest) and the client plugin source (src/client/, built to client/client.js via tsdown + the normalize-client-banner envelope) — extracted for the dshd-gui phase of the modular Cordis split. D5 (modularization, 2026-08-29): dshd-gui is the OWNER of the `deepartments-client` surface — the client build/normalize source lives HERE (tsdown.config.ts + scripts/normalize-client-banner.mjs, the single source-of-truth build), and the bundle's ./client is a byte-identical R6 mirror (root build:client = `pnpm --filter dshd-gui run build:client && node scripts/mirror-client.mjs`). P1 (modularization, 2026-08-29): the package is NOW ALSO a Cordis PLUGIN (thin name/inject/apply + its own cordis.patch.yml row) providing the `deepartments.gui` service (the /deepartments channel dispatcher/handler with the closure-bound DeepartmentsEndpointDeps injected via the FASE 2.6 binder `gui` bucket — DECOUPLING); the bundle keeps the webServer mount effect + the endpointDeps wiring closure (they bind the live apply-fiber registries) and still consumes this package through the drop-in bridge src/core/gui.ts. The client inject metadata (dsh.client) mirrors the bundle's so a deployment resolves the SAME client entry.
